title: FT-IR spectroscopy with a neural network serotypes Streptococcus pneumoniae prospectively
summary: An artificial neural network on FT-IR spectra (1,603 spectra, 27 serogroups/serotypes) reached 100% cross-validation accuracy. In prospective blind testing of 70 clinical isolates it agreed with the Quellung reaction for 69 (98.6%) and separated vaccine-escape strains 19A, 3 and 6C. An untested serotype (35F) was flagged by a low isolate score.
ai_technology: Artificial neural network classifier on FT-IR spectra

evidence.tested: Prospective blind comparison with the Quellung reference in a public health reference laboratory.
evidence.unknown: The prospective set is small and covers a limited set of serotypes. Abstract-based; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: An ANN classified spectra into pneumococcal serotypes.
